archimate:Principle.name: Common Use Applications
archimate:Principle.documentation: Statement: Development of applications used across the enterprise is preferred over the development of similar or duplicative applications which are only provided to a particular organization. Rationale: Reduces redundancy, maintenance costs, and enables better data sharing post-merger. Implication: Organizations which depend on a capability which does not serve the entire enterprise must change over to the replacement enterprise-wide capability.
